name: Captain Marley

abilities.name: Shock
abilities.description: A basic ranged attack dealing minor shock damage.

abilities.name: Impending Storm
abilities.description: Captain Marley charges up and releases lightning from himself as indicated by red circles dealing moderate shock damage to all targets hit. This can be interrupted to stagger Captain Marley.

abilities.name: Waterspout
abilities.description: Captain Marley conjures raging water that surges up from the ground and flows forward, indicated by a circular AoE, dealing moderate shock damage and knocking you away. This can be interrupted to stagger Captain Marley.

abilities.name: Summon Totem
abilities.description: Captain Marley periodically summons a Totem (Ghost Haven Bay) which periodically deals lightning strikes that travel in a line, each dealing moderate shock damage. Multiple totems can be up at once.

abilities.name: Steak
abilities.description: Captain Marley uses a Streak-like ability, dashing to his target as a bolt of electricity.

abilities.name: Run Away!
abilities.description: When close to Captain Marley, backs up to put some distance between his target and himself.

dialogue.speaker: Captain Marley
dialogue.line: We're spared Oblivion, can't you see? He's saved us!

dialogue.speaker: Captain Marley
dialogue.line: The Commodore knows best. Don't question him!
